body:
Step 2a of docs/ios-port-design.md. Replace Hilt with Koin in :app: modules for the repositories,
the account registry, platform services and every view model (koinViewModel in the screens),
WorkManager workers through Koin's WorkManager support. Hilt plugins and dependencies leave the
build. No user-visible change; the existing screen and Robolectric tests keep passing with test
wiring rebuilt on Koin. The ThemeTest-style source guards that mention Hilt follow.
title: iPhone port step 2a: Hilt out, Koin in
